goal_obligations.predicate: Project root contains an index.html file.
The page allows adding books with non-empty title and author and multiple tags (comma input, trimmed, lowercased, deduplicated) and deleting books.
The page provides search by title or author and multiple tag checkbox filtering with AND intersection, combined with search.
The page allows exporting the entire list as a downloadable JSON file.

The page allows importing books via file selection, validates the entire batch before replacing, shows an alert with role='alert' containing 'rejected' on any error, and leaves the original list unchanged.
The import validation enforces version=1, books array, correct field types, non-empty title/author/id, unique non-empty id strings, and tags array of strings.

The page has public UI elements with accessible names as specified: Book title, Author, Tags fields; Add book, Export JSON, Import books buttons; Import JSON file input; Search books input; each tag checkbox accessible name 'Tag: 标签'; each book article accessible name 'Book 标题' with author, tags, Delete button.
The page starts with no data and persists all committed changes using localStorage so that refreshing the browser preserves them.
README.md contains instructions for starting the server and manual verification steps.
The project uses no remote CDN, external network, or downloadable packages; all resources are local.
Verification of behavior is performed through real browser operation, not by reading CSS length or source keywords.

success_evidence: README.md now contains a section describing how to run the app (e.g., python -m http.server) and steps for manual verification of all features.

steps.objective: Run a comprehensive browser automation test that starts a local server, interacts with the page through a real browser (e.g., via Selenium or Playwright if available), and verifies all functional and accessibility requirements: add/delete, tag processing, search/filter, export, import with validation and error alerts, persistence across reloads, accessible names, and initial empty state.
success_evidence: Browser automation script executed successfully; all assertions passed, confirming the features work as specified and accessible names are correct; alert with 'rejected' displayed on invalid import and original list remains unchanged.

patch.reason: Initial plan to create the reading list app and verify through real browser interaction.

goal_obligations.predicate: Project root contains an index.html file.
The page allows adding books with non-empty title and author and multiple tags (comma input, trimmed, lowercased, deduplicated) and deleting books.
The page provides search by title or author and multiple tag checkbox filtering with AND intersection, combined with search.
The page allows exporting the entire list as a downloadable JSON file.

The page allows importing books via file selection, validates the entire batch before replacing, shows an alert with role='alert' containing 'rejected' on any error, and leaves the original list unchanged.
The import validation enforces version=1, books array, correct field types, non-empty title/author/id, unique non-empty id strings, and tags array of strings.

The page has public UI elements with accessible names as specified: Book title, Author, Tags fields; Add book, Export JSON, Import books buttons; Import JSON file input; Search books input; each tag checkbox accessible name 'Tag: 标签'; each book article accessible name 'Book 标题' with author, tags, Delete button.
The page starts with no data and persists all committed changes using localStorage so that refreshing the browser preserves them.
README.md contains instructions for starting the server and manual verification steps.
The project uses no remote CDN, external network, or downloadable packages; all resources are local.
Verification of behavior is performed through real browser operation, not by reading CSS length or source keywords.
